subhero.en: Tradjenta (linagliptin) carries a list price of roughly $630 per month for 30 tablets in 2026. No generic linagliptin is commercially available in US pharmacies as of June 2026, despite an FDA tentative approval granted in 2021. Under the Inflation Reduction Act, CMS negotiated a Maximum Fair Price of $78 per 30-day supply for Tradjenta, but that price applies to Medicare Part D enrollees beginning January 1, 2027, not 2026. Commercially insured patients can use the Boehringer Ingelheim savings card to pay as little as $10 per fill. Uninsured patients at or below 400 percent of the federal poverty level may qualify for free Tradjenta through the BI Cares Foundation patient assistance program.

Commercially insured patients can access the Boehringer Ingelheim savings card to pay as little as $10 per fill. Uninsured patients at or below 400 percent of the federal poverty level may qualify for free Tradjenta through the BI Cares patient assistance program.

introParagraphs.en: Tradjenta (linagliptin) is a once-daily 5 mg oral tablet approved by the FDA in May 2011 for adults with type 2 diabetes. Boehringer Ingelheim and Eli Lilly co-developed and co-marketed the drug. Linagliptin works by blocking the DPP-4 enzyme, which causes the body's natural incretin hormones (GLP-1 and GIP) to remain active longer after meals, suppressing glucagon and supporting insulin release in a glucose-dependent manner. Unlike some older diabetes drugs, linagliptin is cleared primarily by the liver and does not require renal dose adjustment, which makes it a common choice for patients with reduced kidney function. The combination tablets Jentadueto (linagliptin plus metformin) and Jentadueto XR (extended-release) and the SGLT2-plus-DPP4 combination Glyxambi (linagliptin plus empagliflozin) use the same active ingredient.
introParagraphs.es: Tradjenta (linagliptina) es una tableta oral de 5 mg de una vez al dia aprobada por la FDA en mayo de 2011 para adultos con diabetes tipo 2. Boehringer Ingelheim y Eli Lilly co-desarrollaron y co-comercializaron el medicamento. La linagliptina actua bloqueando la enzima DPP-4, lo que hace que las hormonas incretinas naturales del cuerpo (GLP-1 y GIP) permanezcan activas por mas tiempo despues de las comidas, suprimiendo el glucagon y apoyando la liberacion de insulina de forma dependiente de la glucosa. A diferencia de algunos medicamentos para la diabetes mas antiguos, la linagliptina se elimina principalmente por el higado y no requiere ajuste de dosis renal, lo que la convierte en una opcion comun para pacientes con funcion renal reducida. Las tabletas combinadas Jentadueto (linagliptina mas metformina) y Glyxambi (linagliptina mas empagliflozina) usan el mismo principio activo.

introParagraphs.en: Tradjenta's 2026 list price runs approximately $630 per month at the pharmacy counter. Boehringer Ingelheim has protected the drug with an extensive patent portfolio, and despite an FDA tentative approval of a generic linagliptin in 2021, no generic has reached US pharmacy shelves as of June 2026. The absence of generic competition keeps cash prices high for patients without insurance or whose plan does not cover the drug. Patients with Medicare Part D should be aware that the IRA negotiated price of $78 per month for Tradjenta does not take effect until January 1, 2027. In 2026, Medicare Part D enrollees remain subject to their plan's formulary tier and the general $2,100 annual out-of-pocket cap across all Part D drugs. Patients combining Tradjenta with [metformin](/en/drug/metformin-cost) often have Jentadueto as a formulary option, which may be tiered differently than standalone Tradjenta. For patients considering an SGLT2 inhibitor such as [Jardiance](/en/drug/jardiance-cost) or [Farxiga](/en/drug/farxiga-cost) as an alternative, these drugs also carry prior authorization requirements on most commercial plans.
introParagraphs.es: El precio de lista de Tradjenta en 2026 ronda los $630 al mes en la farmacia. Boehringer Ingelheim ha protegido el medicamento con una extensa cartera de patentes, y a pesar de una aprobacion provisional de linagliptina generica por la FDA en 2021, ningun generico ha llegado a las farmacias de EE.UU. a junio de 2026. La ausencia de competencia generica mantiene altos los precios en efectivo para pacientes sin seguro o cuyo plan no cubre el medicamento. Los pacientes con Medicare Parte D deben saber que el precio negociado por la IRA de $78 al mes para Tradjenta no entra en vigor hasta el 1 de enero de 2027.

introParagraphs.en: Two programs from Boehringer Ingelheim can meaningfully lower Tradjenta cost in 2026. Commercially insured patients who pay more than $10 per fill out of pocket can use the Tradjenta Savings Card to reduce their cost-share to $10 per 30-day, 60-day, or 90-day supply. Uninsured and underinsured patients at or below 400 percent of the federal poverty level may apply to the BI Cares Foundation patient assistance program, which can supply Tradjenta free of charge. Patients with Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, or VA coverage cannot legally use the manufacturer coupon but can use the income-based patient assistance program instead. Patients who qualify for [Medicaid](/en/medicaid-income-limits) typically pay $1 to $4 per prescription under the nominal Medicaid copay structure, which varies by state.
introParagraphs.es: Dos programas de Boehringer Ingelheim pueden reducir significativamente el costo de Tradjenta en 2026. Los pacientes con seguro comercial que pagan mas de $10 por surtido pueden usar la Tarjeta de Ahorros de Tradjenta para reducir su participacion en el costo a $10 por suministro de 30, 60 o 90 dias. Los pacientes sin seguro o con seguro insuficiente con ingresos iguales o inferiores al 400 por ciento del nivel federal de pobreza pueden solicitar el programa de asistencia al paciente de la Fundacion BI Cares, que puede suministrar Tradjenta de forma gratuita. Los pacientes con Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE o cobertura de VA no pueden usar legalmente el cupon del fabricante, pero pueden usar el programa de asistencia basado en ingresos.

paragraphs.en: Tradjenta is an outpatient oral tablet prescribed for chronic blood sugar management. Patients almost never receive it in a hospital setting as an administered drug. When Tradjenta appears on an inpatient hospital bill, it is usually because a hospitalized diabetic patient brought their own supply, and the facility pharmacy dispensed a replacement dose during the stay. In that scenario, the charge can easily run two to four times the retail price. Hospitals apply facility fee markups, pharmacy handling fees, and compounding charges even for oral tablets that require no preparation beyond handing a pill to the patient. A 30-tablet pack that retails for $630 at the pharmacy counter may be billed at $900 to $2,200 on an itemized hospital bill.
paragraphs.es: Tradjenta es una tableta oral ambulatoria recetada para el control cronico del azucar en sangre. Los pacientes casi nunca la reciben en un entorno hospitalario como medicamento administrado. Cuando Tradjenta aparece en una factura hospitalaria de internacion, generalmente es porque un paciente diabetico hospitalizado trajo su propio suministro y la farmacia de la instalacion dispenso una dosis de reemplazo durante la estadía. En ese escenario, el cargo puede facilmente superar dos a cuatro veces el precio minorista. Los hospitales aplican recargos de tarifas de instalacion, tarifas de manejo de farmacia y cargos de preparacion incluso para tabletas orales que no requieren ninguna preparacion mas alla de entregar una pastilla al paciente.

paragraphs.en: Three structural factors drive hospital pharmacy markups on oral diabetes medications. First, hospitals operate under charge master pricing that sets list charges independent of acquisition costs. The actual hospital acquisition cost for a 30-day supply of Tradjenta is generally close to the wholesale acquisition cost ($630), but the charge master rate applied to the bill may be 40 to 250 percent higher. Second, prior authorization and formulary appeals are handled differently in inpatient settings, meaning costs get passed through without the insurer's negotiated discount applying automatically. Third, facility fees are charged on top of drug costs when the dispensing event is associated with an inpatient stay. If you see Tradjenta on an itemized bill above $800 for a 30-day supply equivalent, request an itemized charge breakdown by National Drug Code (NDC), compare to the 2026 wholesale acquisition cost, and file a billing dispute with the hospital's patient financial services office.
paragraphs.es: Tres factores estructurales impulsan los recargos de las farmacias hospitalarias en medicamentos orales para la diabetes. Primero, los hospitales operan con precios de master de cargos que establecen cargos de lista independientes de los costos de adquisicion. Segundo, las apelaciones de autorizacion previa y formulario se manejan de manera diferente en entornos de internacion, lo que significa que los costos se transfieren sin que el descuento negociado por el asegurador se aplique automaticamente. Tercero, se cobran tarifas de instalacion ademas de los costos de medicamentos cuando el evento de dispensacion esta asociado con una estancia de internacion.

intro.en: Boehringer Ingelheim offers two separate cost-reduction programs for Tradjenta in 2026: a commercial savings card for insured patients and an income-based patient assistance program for uninsured and underinsured patients. The savings card reduces your cost-share to $10 per fill for commercially insured patients. The BI Cares Foundation patient assistance program can supply Tradjenta free of charge for patients at or below 400 percent of the federal poverty level who lack adequate prescription drug coverage. These two programs serve different populations and cannot be stacked.
intro.es: Boehringer Ingelheim ofrece dos programas separados de reduccion de costos para Tradjenta en 2026: una tarjeta de ahorros comercial para pacientes asegurados y un programa de asistencia al paciente basado en ingresos para pacientes sin seguro o con seguro insuficiente. La tarjeta de ahorros reduce su participacion en el costo a $10 por surtido para pacientes con seguro comercial. El programa de asistencia al paciente de la Fundacion BI Cares puede suministrar Tradjenta de forma gratuita para pacientes con ingresos iguales o inferiores al 400 por ciento del nivel federal de pobreza que carecen de cobertura adecuada de medicamentos recetados.

paragraphs.en: Tradjenta is a Medicare Part D drug, covered for adults with type 2 diabetes. In 2026, your total annual out-of-pocket cost across all Part D drugs combined is capped at $2,100 under the Inflation Reduction Act. Once you reach $2,100 in out-of-pocket Part D spending in a calendar year, you pay $0 for the rest of the year on covered drugs, including Tradjenta. Most Part D plans that cover Tradjenta place it on a mid-tier formulary level, typically Tier 3 or Tier 4, which means copays before the catastrophic threshold can run $50 to $120 per fill depending on the plan. Patients enrolled in Extra Help (Low-Income Subsidy) from Medicare pay dramatically less, often $3 to $10 per fill, and are not subject to the full out-of-pocket phase.
paragraphs.es: Tradjenta es un medicamento de Medicare Parte D, cubierto para adultos con diabetes tipo 2. En 2026, su costo anual total de bolsillo en todos los medicamentos de Parte D combinados esta limitado a $2,100 bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion. Una vez que alcanza los $2,100 en gastos de bolsillo de Parte D en un ano calendario, paga $0 por el resto del ano en medicamentos cubiertos, incluyendo Tradjenta. La mayoria de los planes de Parte D que cubren Tradjenta lo colocan en un nivel de formulario intermedio, tipicamente Nivel 3 o Nivel 4, lo que significa que los copagos antes del umbral catastrofico pueden oscilar entre $50 y $120 por surtido segun el plan.

paragraphs.en: Starting January 1, 2027, Medicare beneficiaries will pay a Maximum Fair Price of $78 per 30-day supply of Tradjenta. This represents an 84 percent reduction from the current list price and results from the second round of IRA drug price negotiations (IPAY 2027), which CMS announced in November 2025. Tradjenta's ceiling was set at the Part D net price of approximately $194 rather than the statutory discount formula, because rebates from the list price were among the highest in the cohort at 58 percent. The practical impact: in 2026, Medicare patients still pay standard plan rates. In 2027, that exposure drops sharply for most enrollees. Patients who are approaching the 2026 formulary coverage gap should speak with their plan about the Medicare Prescription Payment Plan, which spreads Part D out-of-pocket costs evenly across the calendar year.
paragraphs.es: A partir del 1 de enero de 2027, los beneficiarios de Medicare pagaran un Precio Maximo Justo de $78 por suministro de 30 dias de Tradjenta. Esto representa una reduccion del 84 por ciento con respecto al precio de lista actual y resulta de la segunda ronda de negociaciones de precios de medicamentos de la IRA (IPAY 2027), que CMS anuncio en noviembre de 2025. El techo de Tradjenta se establecio en el precio neto de Parte D de aproximadamente $194 en lugar de la formula de descuento estatutaria, porque los reembolsos del precio de lista estaban entre los mas altos del grupo, al 58 por ciento.

paragraphs.en: Medicare plans are not required to include Tradjenta on their formulary if another DPP-4 inhibitor or competing class drug (SGLT2 inhibitor, GLP-1 receptor agonist) is available. If Tradjenta is not on your plan's formulary in 2026, your prescriber can file a formulary exception request documenting a medically necessary reason you require linagliptin specifically (for example, renal impairment that makes other agents less appropriate). Prior authorization is commonly required even when Tradjenta is covered, and step therapy requiring trial of a first-line oral agent such as metformin is standard before coverage is authorized. Patients who qualify for Medicaid typically pay $1 to $4 per Tradjenta prescription under the state's nominal copay structure, which varies by state and may vary by recipient category.
paragraphs.es: Los planes de Medicare no estan obligados a incluir Tradjenta en su formulario si hay disponible otro inhibidor de DPP-4 o medicamento de clase competidora. Si Tradjenta no esta en el formulario de su plan en 2026, su medico puede presentar una solicitud de excepcion al formulario documentando una razon medicamente necesaria por la que requiere linagliptina especificamente. La autorizacion previa se requiere comunmente incluso cuando Tradjenta esta cubierta, y la terapia escalonada que requiere prueba de un agente oral de primera linea como la metformina es estandar antes de que se autorice la cobertura.

intro.en: If you received a bill for Tradjenta above $200 per month with commercial insurance, or above $150 per month on Medicare Part D, check for these issues before paying:
intro.es: Si recibio una factura por Tradjenta de mas de $200 al mes con seguro comercial, o mas de $150 al mes con Medicare Parte D, verifique estos problemas antes de pagar:

items.en: Prior authorization not submitted or expired: most commercial and Medicare Part D plans require PA for brand-name DPP-4 inhibitors. If your prescriber did not submit or renew prior authorization, the plan defaults to the full cash price.
items.es: Autorizacion previa no presentada o vencida: la mayoria de los planes comerciales y de Medicare Parte D requieren autorizacion previa para los inhibidores de DPP-4 de marca. Si su medico no presento o renovo la autorizacion previa, el plan aplica el precio completo en efectivo.

items.en: Savings card not applied at the pharmacy counter for commercially insured patients. The Boehringer Ingelheim savings card reduces your cost-share to $10, but the pharmacist must scan the card's BIN and PCN numbers at the register.
items.es: Tarjeta de ahorros no aplicada en el mostrador de la farmacia para pacientes con seguro comercial. La tarjeta de ahorros de Boehringer Ingelheim reduce su participacion en el costo a $10, pero el farmaceutico debe escanear los numeros BIN y PCN de la tarjeta en la caja.

items.en: Jentadueto billed separately from metformin when the combination tablet was prescribed: Jentadueto is a single combination product and should be billed as one fill, not as two separate medications.
items.es: Jentadueto facturado por separado de la metformina cuando se receto la tableta de combinacion: Jentadueto es un producto de combinacion unico y debe facturarse como un surtido, no como dos medicamentos separados.

items.en: Charged at the non-formulary rate when the drug should be on-formulary: confirm with your plan whether Tradjenta is on your formulary and at what tier. A formulary exception or tier exception request can reduce your cost-share.
items.es: Cobrado a la tarifa fuera del formulario cuando el medicamento deberia estar en el formulario: confirme con su plan si Tradjenta esta en su formulario y en que nivel. Una solicitud de excepcion al formulario o de nivel puede reducir su participacion en el costo.

items.en: Billed for the 2026 list price after the 2027 MFP takes effect starting January 1, 2027: once the IRA Maximum Fair Price of $78 is effective, Medicare plans must apply that rate. Report billing above $78 per month for Tradjenta to your plan or to 1-800-MEDICARE after January 1, 2027.
items.es: Facturado al precio de lista 2026 despues de que el MFP de 2027 entre en vigor a partir del 1 de enero de 2027: una vez que el Precio Maximo Justo de $78 de la IRA sea efectivo, los planes de Medicare deben aplicar esa tarifa. Reporte la facturacion por encima de $78 al mes por Tradjenta a su plan o al 1-800-MEDICARE despues del 1 de enero de 2027.

note.en: No generic linagliptin is commercially available at US pharmacies as of June 2026. The FDA granted a tentative approval to a generic version in 2021, but Boehringer Ingelheim's patent portfolio continues to block commercial market entry. CMS's IRA IPAY 2027 fact sheet notes that generics are expected to enter later in 2026 or 2027, which could result in Tradjenta being removed from the IRA negotiation list for subsequent years. Patients should ask their pharmacist in late 2026 whether a generic has reached pharmacy shelves. Tradjenta is a small-molecule drug and is not a biologic, so biosimilars are not applicable.
note.es: No hay linagliptina generica disponible comercialmente en farmacias de EE.UU. a junio de 2026. La FDA otorgo una aprobacion provisional a una version generica en 2021, pero la cartera de patentes de Boehringer Ingelheim continua bloqueando la entrada comercial al mercado. El documento de hechos de IPAY 2027 de CMS senala que se espera que los genericos entren a finales de 2026 o 2027. Tradjenta es un medicamento de molecula pequena y no es un biologico, por lo que los biosimilares no son aplicables.

appealSteps.en: Step 1: Request a written denial notice from your insurance plan. The denial letter must state the specific reason for denial and your appeal rights. Keep a copy.
appealSteps.es: Paso 1: Solicite un aviso de denegacion por escrito de su plan de seguro. La carta de denegacion debe indicar la razon especifica de la denegacion y sus derechos de apelacion. Conserve una copia.

appealSteps.en: Step 2: File a formal internal appeal within 60 days of the denial. Include a letter of medical necessity from your prescriber explaining why Tradjenta (linagliptin) is required specifically, not just any DPP-4 inhibitor. Common medical necessity reasons include renal impairment, documented intolerance to alternative agents, or prior therapeutic failure.
appealSteps.es: Paso 2: Presente una apelacion interna formal dentro de los 60 dias posteriores a la denegacion. Incluya una carta de necesidad medica de su medico explicando por que se requiere Tradjenta (linagliptina) especificamente. Las razones comunes de necesidad medica incluyen deterioro renal, intolerancia documentada a agentes alternativos o falla terapeutica previa.

appealSteps.en: Step 3: Ask your prescriber to file a peer-to-peer review with the plan's medical director. Peer-to-peer reviews are often the single most effective step for overturning prior authorization denials for brand-name diabetes medications.
appealSteps.es: Paso 3: Pida a su medico que solicite una revision entre pares con el director medico del plan. Las revisiones entre pares son a menudo el paso mas efectivo para revertir las denegaciones de autorizacion previa para medicamentos de marca para la diabetes.

appealSteps.en: Step 4: Escalate to an external independent review if your internal appeal is denied again. Federal law requires health plans to offer external review for denials involving medical judgment. Contact your state Department of Insurance to start the external review process.
appealSteps.es: Paso 4: Escale a una revision independiente externa si su apelacion interna vuelve a ser denegada. La ley federal requiere que los planes de salud ofrezcan revision externa para denegaciones que involucren juicio medico. Comuniquese con el Departamento de Seguros de su estado para iniciar el proceso de revision externa.

stepTherapyOverride.en: If your plan requires you to try cheaper alternatives first (step therapy) before approving Tradjenta, ask your prescriber to file a step-therapy override. Valid override grounds include: documented allergic reaction or intolerance to the required step agent, medical evidence that the step agent is contraindicated, or documented therapeutic failure on the required step agent within the past 12 months. Renal impairment is particularly strong grounds for linagliptin specifically, since it does not require dose adjustment for kidney disease unlike some alternatives.
stepTherapyOverride.es: Si su plan le exige probar alternativas mas economicas primero (terapia escalonada) antes de aprobar Tradjenta, pida a su medico que presente una anulacion de terapia escalonada. Los motivos validos de anulacion incluyen: reaccion alergica documentada o intolerancia al agente del paso requerido, evidencia medica de que el agente del paso esta contraindicado, o falla terapeutica documentada con el agente del paso requerido en los ultimos 12 meses.

papFallback.en: If insurance appeals fail, apply for the BI Cares Foundation Patient Assistance Program. Uninsured and underinsured patients at or below 400 percent of the federal poverty level can receive Tradjenta free of charge. Income-eligible patients with Medicare who lack adequate drug coverage are also eligible. Call Boehringer Ingelheim at 1-800-556-8317 to start the application or visit the BI Cares program page.
papFallback.es: Si las apelaciones al seguro fallan, solicite el Programa de Asistencia al Paciente de la Fundacion BI Cares. Los pacientes sin seguro o con seguro insuficiente con ingresos iguales o inferiores al 400 por ciento del nivel federal de pobreza pueden recibir Tradjenta de forma gratuita. Los pacientes con ingresos elegibles con Medicare que carecen de cobertura adecuada de medicamentos tambien son elegibles. Llame a Boehringer Ingelheim al 1-800-556-8317 para iniciar la solicitud.

genericAlternative.en: No generic linagliptin is commercially available as of June 2026. If cost is the primary concern and your prescriber agrees, discuss switching to an older DPP-4 inhibitor such as sitagliptin (brand Januvia, generic available May 2026 at approximately $60 to $120 per month with coupons), or a different drug class such as metformin (generic, approximately $4 per month). These are therapeutic alternatives, not chemical equivalents, and require prescriber authorization.
genericAlternative.es: No hay linagliptina generica disponible comercialmente a junio de 2026. Si el costo es la principal preocupacion y su medico esta de acuerdo, considere cambiar a un inhibidor de DPP-4 mas antiguo como la sitagliptina (marca Januvia, generico disponible desde mayo de 2026 a aproximadamente $60 a $120 al mes con cupones), o una clase de medicamento diferente como la metformina (generica, aproximadamente $4 al mes). Estas son alternativas terapeuticas, no equivalentes quimicos, y requieren autorizacion del medico.

howToApplyPap.programName: BI Cares Foundation Patient Assistance Program

numberedSteps.en: Step 1: Visit the Boehringer Ingelheim BI Cares program page at boehringer-ingelheim.us/our-responsibility/patient-assistance-program or call 1-800-556-8317 to request an application packet.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 1: Visite la pagina del programa BI Cares de Boehringer Ingelheim o llame al 1-800-556-8317 para solicitar un paquete de solicitud.

numberedSteps.en: Step 2: Download or request the patient application form. Both the patient section and the prescriber section must be completed and signed. Your prescribing doctor must countersign the application.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 2: Descargue o solicite el formulario de solicitud del paciente. Tanto la seccion del paciente como la del medico deben ser completadas y firmadas. Su medico recetador debe contrafirmar la solicitud.

numberedSteps.en: Step 3: Gather all required documents (see checklist below) and complete the financial information section accurately. Income documentation must reflect current household income, not prior-year income alone.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 3: Reuna todos los documentos requeridos (consulte la lista de verificacion a continuacion) y complete con precision la seccion de informacion financiera. La documentacion de ingresos debe reflejar los ingresos actuales del hogar.

numberedSteps.en: Step 4: Submit your completed application and supporting documents by mail to Boehringer Ingelheim Cares Foundation, PO Box 99055, Jeffersontown, KY 40296. Processing typically takes 7 to 14 business days. Do not fax the application.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 4: Envie su solicitud completada y los documentos de respaldo por correo a Boehringer Ingelheim Cares Foundation, PO Box 99055, Jeffersontown, KY 40296. El procesamiento generalmente toma de 7 a 14 dias habiles. No envie la solicitud por fax.

numberedSteps.en: Step 5: If approved, Tradjenta is shipped free of charge directly to your home address or your prescriber's office, depending on your preference and state law. Renewals are required annually and must include updated income documentation.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 5: Si es aprobado, Tradjenta se envia de forma gratuita directamente a su domicilio o al consultorio de su medico, segun su preferencia y la ley estatal. Las renovaciones son anuales y deben incluir documentacion de ingresos actualizada.

documentsNeeded.en: Most recent federal tax return (Form 1040) OR four consecutive recent pay stubs for all household earners
documentsNeeded.es: Declaracion de impuestos federal mas reciente (Formulario 1040) O cuatro talonarios de pago recientes y consecutivos para todos los que generan ingresos en el hogar

documentsNeeded.en: Proof of US residency: utility bill, lease agreement, or bank statement showing your physical address
documentsNeeded.es: Prueba de residencia en EE.UU.: factura de servicios, contrato de arrendamiento o estado de cuenta bancario que muestre su direccion fisica

documentsNeeded.en: Valid prescription for Tradjenta from a US-licensed prescriber
documentsNeeded.es: Receta valida de Tradjenta de un medico con licencia en EE.UU.

documentsNeeded.en: Prescriber National Provider Identifier (NPI) number (your doctor's office will have this)
documentsNeeded.es: Numero de Identificacion Nacional del Proveedor (NPI) del medico (el consultorio de su medico tendra esto)

documentsNeeded.en: Statement that you have no current prescription drug insurance, or documentation that your Medicare plan does not adequately cover Tradjenta
documentsNeeded.es: Declaracion de que no tiene seguro de medicamentos recetados actual, o documentacion de que su plan de Medicare no cubre adecuadamente Tradjenta

documentsNeeded.en: If Medicare-eligible: documentation that you applied for Medicare Extra Help (Low-Income Subsidy) or were denied
documentsNeeded.es: Si es elegible para Medicare: documentacion de que solicito Ayuda Adicional de Medicare (Subsidio de Bajos Ingresos) o fue denegado

commonDenialReasons.en: Household income exceeds 400 percent of the federal poverty level for your household size
commonDenialReasons.es: Los ingresos del hogar superan el 400 por ciento del nivel federal de pobreza para el tamano de su hogar

commonDenialReasons.en: Patient has active commercial prescription drug insurance that covers Tradjenta (the PAP is for uninsured and underinsured patients only)
commonDenialReasons.es: El paciente tiene seguro de medicamentos recetados comercial activo que cubre Tradjenta (el PAP es solo para pacientes sin seguro o con seguro insuficiente)

commonDenialReasons.en: Application submitted with missing prescriber signature or incomplete financial documentation
commonDenialReasons.es: Solicitud presentada con firma del medico faltante o documentacion financiera incompleta

commonDenialReasons.en: Patient is not a US citizen or legal resident
commonDenialReasons.es: El paciente no es ciudadano o residente legal de EE.UU.

en.question: Is there a generic for Tradjenta in 2026?
en.answer: No. No generic linagliptin is commercially available at US pharmacies as of June 2026. The FDA granted tentative approval to a generic in 2021, but Boehringer Ingelheim's patent portfolio continues to block commercial market entry. CMS has noted that generic competition may arrive later in 2026 or in 2027, which is why Tradjenta was flagged for potential removal from the IRA negotiation list in future cycles. Ask your pharmacist in late 2026 whether a generic has become available. Tradjenta is a small-molecule drug and is not a biologic, so biosimilars are not applicable.

en.question: How do I apply for the BI Cares Foundation patient assistance program for Tradjenta?
en.answer: Call 1-800-556-8317 or visit the Boehringer Ingelheim patient assistance page to download the application. Both the patient and prescriber sections must be completed and signed. Required documents include proof of income (tax return or pay stubs), proof of US residency, a valid Tradjenta prescription, and a statement confirming you have no adequate prescription drug coverage. Mail the completed application to BI Cares Foundation, PO Box 99055, Jeffersontown, KY 40296. Processing takes 7 to 14 business days. If approved, Tradjenta ships free directly to your home. Annual renewal is required with updated income documentation.

en.question: Can I use the Tradjenta savings card with Medicare?
en.answer: No. Federal anti-kickback law (42 U.S.C. 1320a-7b) prohibits manufacturer copay savings cards from being used by anyone enrolled in Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, or VA benefits. The Boehringer Ingelheim Tradjenta savings card is valid only for commercially insured patients who are not covered by any government health program. If you have Medicare, your options are the BI Cares Foundation patient assistance program (free drug for incomes at or below 400 percent FPL), the Extra Help Medicare program (Low-Income Subsidy), or the general Medicare Part D formulary coverage with the $2,100 annual out-of-pocket cap.

en.question: What does Tradjenta cost without insurance at the pharmacy counter in 2026?
en.answer: The cash retail price for Tradjenta 5 mg (30 tablets, 30-day supply) runs approximately $625 to $760 per month in 2026 depending on the pharmacy. With a GoodRx coupon, the price at major chains such as CVS, Walgreens, and Walmart drops to approximately $278 per month. Applying the Boehringer Ingelheim savings card reduces cost further to $10 per fill for commercially insured patients. Uninsured patients who do not qualify for the savings card should apply for the BI Cares Foundation patient assistance program before paying full cash price.

en.question: Does the IRA negotiated price for Tradjenta apply in 2026?
en.answer: No. The IRA Maximum Fair Price of $78 per 30-day supply for Tradjenta was negotiated under the Inflation Reduction Act's second round (IPAY 2027) and takes effect January 1, 2027, not January 1, 2026. In 2026, Medicare Part D enrollees pay standard plan rates for Tradjenta, subject only to the general $2,100 annual out-of-pocket cap across all Part D drugs combined. The $78 price represents an 84 percent reduction from the current list price and will apply automatically to Medicare Part D plans beginning in 2027. CMS announced the negotiated prices in November 2025.

en.question: What if my insurance denies coverage for Tradjenta?
en.answer: Request a written denial notice and file a formal internal appeal within 60 days. Include a medical necessity letter from your prescriber explaining why linagliptin is required. Ask your prescriber to request a peer-to-peer review with the plan's medical director. If the internal appeal fails, escalate to an external independent review through your state Department of Insurance. If you have a renal impairment diagnosis, document it clearly, as linagliptin's lack of renal dose-adjustment requirement is a strong clinical rationale. If all appeals fail, apply for the BI Cares patient assistance program (free drug for incomes at or below 400 percent FPL).

en.question: Do I qualify for the BI Cares patient assistance program for Tradjenta?
en.answer: You likely qualify if your household income is at or below 400 percent of the 2026 federal poverty level and you are uninsured or lack adequate prescription drug coverage. For a household of one, that means annual income at or below $63,840 in 2026. For a household of four, the threshold is $132,000. You must be a US citizen or legal resident, have a valid Tradjenta prescription from a US-licensed prescriber, and not have active commercial prescription drug insurance that covers Tradjenta. Medicare beneficiaries without adequate drug coverage may also qualify. Income thresholds are based on 2026 federal poverty guidelines published by HHS at aspe.hhs.gov.

en.question: How does Tradjenta compare to Januvia (sitagliptin) on cost in 2026?
en.answer: Both Tradjenta (linagliptin) and Januvia (sitagliptin) are DPP-4 inhibitors for type 2 diabetes with similar mechanisms and comparable blood sugar outcomes. However, their 2026 cost picture is very different. Januvia has an IRA Maximum Fair Price of $113 per month effective January 2026 and a generic (sitagliptin) that began launching in May 2026 for approximately $60 to $120 per month with coupons. Tradjenta's IRA price of $78 per month does not take effect until January 2027, and no generic linagliptin is available yet. Clinically, linagliptin has the advantage of requiring no renal dose adjustment. For patients with normal kidney function whose plan covers sitagliptin at a lower tier, generic sitagliptin is likely the more affordable option in 2026.

es.question: Hay un generico de Tradjenta en 2026?
es.answer: No. No hay linagliptina generica disponible comercialmente en farmacias de EE.UU. a junio de 2026. La FDA otorgo una aprobacion provisional a un generico en 2021, pero la cartera de patentes de Boehringer Ingelheim continua bloqueando la entrada comercial al mercado. CMS ha senalado que la competencia generica puede llegar a finales de 2026 o en 2027. Tradjenta es un medicamento de molecula pequena y no es un biologico, por lo que los biosimilares no son aplicables.

es.question: Como solicito el programa de asistencia al paciente de la Fundacion BI Cares para Tradjenta?
es.answer: Llame al 1-800-556-8317 o visite la pagina de asistencia al paciente de Boehringer Ingelheim para descargar la solicitud. Tanto las secciones del paciente como del medico deben ser completadas y firmadas. Los documentos requeridos incluyen prueba de ingresos, prueba de residencia en EE.UU., una receta valida de Tradjenta y una declaracion de que no tiene cobertura adecuada de medicamentos recetados. Envie por correo la solicitud a BI Cares Foundation, PO Box 99055, Jeffersontown, KY 40296. El procesamiento toma de 7 a 14 dias habiles. La renovacion anual es requerida.

es.question: Puedo usar la tarjeta de ahorros de Tradjenta con Medicare?
es.answer: No. La ley federal anti-soborno (42 U.S.C. 1320a-7b) prohibe que las tarjetas de ahorro de copago del fabricante sean utilizadas por cualquier persona inscrita en Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE o beneficios de VA. La tarjeta de ahorros de Tradjenta de Boehringer Ingelheim es valida solo para pacientes con seguro comercial. Si tiene Medicare, sus opciones son el programa de asistencia al paciente de la Fundacion BI Cares, el programa de Ayuda Adicional de Medicare o la cobertura del formulario de Medicare Parte D con el limite anual de $2,100.

es.question: Cuanto cuesta Tradjenta sin seguro en el mostrador de la farmacia en 2026?
es.answer: El precio minorista en efectivo de Tradjenta 5 mg (30 tabletas, suministro de 30 dias) oscila entre $625 y $760 al mes en 2026 segun la farmacia. Con un cupon GoodRx, el precio en las principales cadenas como CVS, Walgreens y Walmart baja a aproximadamente $278 al mes. Aplicar la tarjeta de ahorros de Boehringer Ingelheim reduce el costo a $10 por surtido para pacientes con seguro comercial. Los pacientes sin seguro que no califican para la tarjeta de ahorros deben solicitar el programa de asistencia al paciente de la Fundacion BI Cares antes de pagar el precio completo.

es.question: El precio negociado por la IRA para Tradjenta aplica en 2026?
es.answer: No. El Precio Maximo Justo de la IRA de $78 por suministro de 30 dias para Tradjenta fue negociado bajo la segunda ronda de la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion (IPAY 2027) y entra en vigor el 1 de enero de 2027, no el 1 de enero de 2026. En 2026, los inscritos en Medicare Parte D pagan las tarifas estandar del plan para Tradjenta, sujetos solo al limite anual general de $2,100 en todos los medicamentos de Parte D combinados.

es.question: Que hago si mi seguro rechaza la cobertura de Tradjenta?
es.answer: Solicite un aviso de denegacion por escrito y presente una apelacion interna formal dentro de los 60 dias. Incluya una carta de necesidad medica de su medico. Pida a su medico que solicite una revision entre pares con el director medico del plan. Si la apelacion interna falla, escale a una revision independiente externa a traves del Departamento de Seguros de su estado. Si todas las apelaciones fallan, solicite el programa de asistencia al paciente de BI Cares (medicamento gratis para ingresos iguales o inferiores al 400 por ciento del FPL).

es.question: Califico para el programa de asistencia al paciente de BI Cares para Tradjenta?
es.answer: Probablemente califique si sus ingresos del hogar son iguales o inferiores al 400 por ciento del nivel federal de pobreza de 2026 y no tiene seguro o carece de cobertura adecuada de medicamentos recetados. Para un hogar de una persona, eso significa ingresos anuales iguales o inferiores a $63,840 en 2026. Para un hogar de cuatro personas, el umbral es $132,000. Debe ser ciudadano o residente legal de EE.UU. y tener una receta valida de Tradjenta de un medico con licencia en EE.UU.

es.question: Como se compara el costo de Tradjenta con Januvia (sitagliptina) en 2026?
es.answer: Ambos son inhibidores de DPP-4 para la diabetes tipo 2 con mecanismos similares y resultados comparables en el control del azucar en sangre. Sin embargo, su panorama de costos en 2026 es muy diferente. Januvia tiene un Precio Maximo Justo de $113 al mes efectivo enero 2026, y un generico (sitagliptina) disponible desde mayo de 2026 por aproximadamente $60 a $120 al mes con cupones. El precio IRA de Tradjenta de $78 al mes no entra en vigor hasta enero de 2027, y no hay linagliptina generica disponible todavia. Para pacientes con funcion renal normal cuyo plan cubre sitagliptina a un nivel mas bajo, la sitagliptina generica es probablemente la opcion mas economica en 2026.
